name: Correggio (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Correggio (a yellow sun on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Correggio, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Correggio arms — yellow sun on blue, crowned, within branches
